A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same NeFIC work, and their text, equations, figures and tables support reliable comparison. All 17 pages of v1 and 21 pages of v3 were inspected. Neither contains an appendix; supplementary material mentioned in both is not included in the supplied files.

before.justification: v1 reports original compression benchmarks, runtime measurements, qualitative reconstructions and component, LoRA and foundation-model ablations in Section 4.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds generated refocus-video examples in Figure 2.

M1.justification: The anchor codec, CogVideoX backbone, two-stage training, conditional encoding, bypass refinement, losses and one-step decoding remain unchanged. Shortened descriptions and corrected encoder notation do not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both train on Flickr2W and evaluate image compression on Kodak, DIV2K and CLIC2020. The new refocus examples extend the existing blur-to-sharp demonstration without establishing a distinct task, population or evaluation scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding benchmark, runtime and foundation-model comparisons. OneDC remains in Table 1 despite disappearing from v3's baseline-list prose. FLUX-12B is relabeled Flux-dev-12B, already identified that way in v1's accompanying text.

E3.justification: The reported crop range, batch size, 10k/50k training budgets, learning-rate schedule, evaluation metrics, full-image versus patch evaluation and runtime procedure are unchanged. The additional refocus examples introduce no distinct documented evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: v3 Figure 2 adds qualitative cases illustrating pretrained VDM refocusing, extending the existing parrot demonstration. Component, LoRA and FLUX ablations are unchanged. The anchor-versus-bypass analysis moves from Section 4.5 to 4.3 rather than being newly added.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The discussion of Kodak's insufficient size for reliable FID/KID estimation is retained.

E6.justification: Figure 2 adds qualitative refocusing outputs. Matched numerical results remain unchanged across Tables 1–3 and the renumbered LoRA and foundation-model tables. For example, CLIC2020 LPIPS BD-rate remains -64.09%, and DIV2K decoding time remains 6.83 seconds.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), diffusion parameterization and loss definitions are unchanged. Correcting the encoder notation in Section 3.5 is typographical; no substantive definition, derivation, assumption or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract replaces the explicit claim of superior objective and subjective performance with superior rate-distortion performance, modestly narrowing its wording and scope. The central paradigm, one-step decoding contribution, over-50% bitrate-savings claim and up-to-5x speedup claim remain.

C2.justification: v3's foundation-model discussion adds the interpretation that the T2I comparator benefits from T2I models' generally stronger visual realism relative to T2V models. Existing explanations of temporal conditioning, latent alignment and fidelity-versus-realism tradeoffs are otherwise retained.

D1.justification: The abstract now identifies a planned NeFIC GitHub repository instead of merely promising a later code release; it does not establish current availability. Section 3.5 also drops explicit 1/8-scale feature descriptions, slightly reducing implementation detail without documenting a setting change.

R1.justification: v3 adds the citation to Autoregressive-based Progressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression and drops the VCIP 2025 ultra-low-bitrate video-compression challenge citation. Most remaining changes are reference reordering, metadata corrections or naming corrections; the central research positioning remains.

P1.justification: v3 polishes wording, brings the blur-to-sharp motivation into the introduction, moves the anchor-and-bypass subsection earlier, aligns ablation names with the prose and adds acknowledgments. Most paragraphs and the overall narrative are retained.

P2.justification: The document undergoes extensive reformatting, with new typography, narrower text blocks, running headers and widespread figure/table repositioning. Previously adjacent tables are separated, captions and table styling change, and a new refocus montage is added as Figure 2. Existing scientific diagrams and plots are largely preserved.

improvement.justification: The added refocus examples, earlier explanation of the temporal prior, consistent ablation labels and narrower abstract claim modestly improve clarity and support. The planned repository location improves traceability, although code remains promised and some explicit feature-scale detail is lost. The core method and quantitative evidence are unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
